name: library_mining
title: Mine repos for reusable libraries
description: Point it at several existing repos (one per line in target_path.txt). Read-only. The agents find repeated patterns across the portfolio and propose reusable libraries + an extraction plan. No build phase.

phases.title: Portfolio recon
phases.purpose: Map each repo in the portfolio READ-ONLY: language/framework, key third-party dependencies, and the notable structural pieces (models, networking, persistence, onboarding, design system, utilities). Produce a concise per-repo summary. NO recommendations yet.

phases.title: Commonalities
phases.purpose: Debate ACROSS the repos: which patterns are independently reimplemented in multiple repos (networking boilerplate, persistence layer, onboarding flow, design tokens, helpers)? Distinguish genuinely reusable commonalities from superficially-similar-but-different code. Cite the repos/files where each recurs.

phases.title: Extraction plan
phases.purpose: Rank the top reusable-library candidates by how many repos would benefit, how stable the pattern is (rewritten differently each time = not stable enough to extract yet), and extraction effort. For each: a proposed package name, a public API sketch, which repos would adopt it, and rough effort. End with the top 3 to extract first. Put the final report under a '## Final Output' heading.
